name: AI Foundations Bootcamp
tagline: Learn to build with AI in 4 weeks
description: A 4-week live bootcamp that takes students and junior developers from AI basics to a working project: prompting, APIs, simple agents and deployment.
faq_seed: When do the sessions take place?
What is the difference between Standard and Pro?

policies.refund: Refund within 7 days if fewer than 2 sessions attended.
policies.schedule: Sessions run Monday to Thursday, 18:00-20:00 Tunisia time, for 4 weeks.
policies.prerequisites: Basic Python knowledge is helpful; no prior AI experience is required.
policies.certificate: A certificate of completion is issued to students who attend at least 12 of 16 sessions.
